dependency_edge: Rhetorical energeia presupposes metaphysical sense (activity/aliveness as mode of being)
conflict_edge: Metaphysical sense is abstract and atemporal (priority thesis); rhetorical sense is concrete and perceptual (vividness)
tension_description: Whether the Rhetoric's energeia is a genuine application of the Metaphysics concept or a homonymous appropriation. The transfer from ontological priority to aesthetic vividness is Aristotle's most striking conceptual redeployment, and the mechanism of connection is never made explicit.

node_a: psyche (DA II.1: first entelecheia of natural body; inseparable from body)
node_b: nous (DA III.5: active nous is separable, immortal, eternal)
dependency_edge: Nous is a capacity of soul; hylomorphic definition should govern all psychic capacities
conflict_edge: Active nous breaches the hylomorphic framework: separable, immortal, eternal (430a17-22)
tension_description: The fundamental tension of De Anima. The hylomorphic definition that governs all other psychic faculties is violated at the highest point. Reverberates into Met Lambda (divine self-thinking) and the theological tradition.

node_a: kinesis (Phys III.2: energeia ateles, incomplete actuality)
node_b: energeia (Met Theta.8: actuality prior in formula, time, substance)
dependency_edge: Physics definition deploys the actuality concept from Metaphysics Theta
conflict_edge: Incomplete actuality is paradoxical within a framework where actuality = completion
tension_description: The central interpretive crux connecting Physics and Metaphysics. Whether kinesis constitutes a genuine third ontological category between potentiality and completed actuality, or is merely a conceptual device, remains the most debated question in Aristotle's process ontology.

node_a: phantasia (DA III.3: kinesis from actual sensation — causally derived)
node_b: phantasia (DA/Rhet/Mem/MA: functionally autonomous in dreams, deliberation, rhetoric, involuntary movement)
dependency_edge: Phantasia originates in sensation and inherits its reliability structure
conflict_edge: A causally dependent capacity achieves operational independence across all four application domains
tension_description: Phantasia's causal derivation from sensation conflicts with its functional autonomy in four domains: dreaming (DA), rhetorical reception (Rhet pro ommaton poiein), memory retention (Mem phantasma as likeness), and involuntary physiology (MA blushing/trembling). How a dependent capacity achieves independence is raised but never resolved.

node_a: telos (Phys II.8: nature acts for an end without deliberating)
node_b: techne (Phys II.8: art acts purposively through deliberation)
dependency_edge: Teleological argument relies on art-nature analogy
conflict_edge: Stripping deliberation while retaining purposiveness undermines the analogy
tension_description: Whether non-deliberative purposiveness is genuinely explanatory or covertly metaphorical. Extends to Movement of Animals where the practical syllogism compresses deliberative structure to vanishing point in rapid action.

node_a: practical syllogism (MA ch. 7: universal major + particular minor = action)
node_b: orexis (MA/DA: desire as proximate efficient cause of locomotion)
dependency_edge: The practical syllogism formalizes the desire-perception-action chain
conflict_edge: The conclusion is an action, not a proposition; rapid-action cases compress deliberation to nothing
tension_description: Whether the practical syllogism is a genuine logical form or a psychological causal sequence dressed in logical language. Bridges logic and psychology in a way that threatens the integrity of both.

node_a: nous (DA III.4: impassible, unmixed, without nature of its own)
node_b: phantasma (DA III.7: the soul never thinks without an image)
dependency_edge: Nous depends on phantasmata for all operations
conflict_edge: Phantasmata are bodily residues of sensation; nous is supposed to be free of bodily determination
tension_description: The wax-signet model applied to both sense and thought threatens to collapse the distinction between embodied perception and separable intellection. If nous genuinely requires bodily images, its separability claim is undermined.

node_b: to_agathon (Met Lambda.10: the good as both separate principle and immanent cosmic order)
dependency_edge: God's thinking is the supreme actuality; the universe's order depends on it
conflict_edge: A self-thinking god has no cognition of the world he orders
tension_description: How a self-thinking god can govern worldly order without cognizing it. If God thinks only himself, the mechanism by which divine thought structures cosmic order is opaque.

node_a: eidos (Met Z.viii: man generates man — form shared across instances)
node_b: eidos (Met Z.xiii: no universal is substance — form must be individual)
dependency_edge: Form is substance; substance must be a 'this' not a 'such'
conflict_edge: If form is numerically the same across instances it is universal; if numerically distinct, what individuates it?
tension_description: The fundamental tension of Metaphysics Z, never resolved. The Categories' treatment of individual composites as primary substance adds a further layer. Whether Aristotle's mature position is that individual forms are particular is one of the most debated questions in Aristotle scholarship.

node_a: chronos (Phys IV.11: number of motion — grounded in motion, mind-independent)
node_b: chronos (Phys IV.14: time qua numbered requires soul as counter)
dependency_edge: Time is defined through motion but counting requires psyche
conflict_edge: Ambiguous ontological status: mind-independent or mind-dependent?
tension_description: Extends to On Memory where time is the necessary condition of memory and only time-perceiving animals can remember, binding physics to psychology. Aristotle hedges: motion can exist without soul, but time as numbered cannot.

node_a: rhetorike (Rhet I.1: morally neutral capacity that can be misused)
node_b: rhetorike (Rhet I.1: truth and justice are naturally stronger)
dependency_edge: Rhetoric is a genuine techne with systematic rational structure
conflict_edge: Value-neutrality claim conflicts with truth-orientation; art-concealing-art deepens paradox
tension_description: The constitutive tension of the Rhetoric. If truth is naturally stronger, rhetoric should be superfluous; if rhetoric is needed, truth's natural strength is insufficient. The naturalness principle (art concealing art) makes the most truthful-seeming speech the most artfully constructed.

node_a: phantasma (Mem: object of contemplation in itself, theorema)
node_b: phantasma (Mem: likeness of the thing remembered, eikon)
dependency_edge: Memory consists in perceiving the phantasma qua likeness
conflict_edge: The shift from in-itself to qua-likeness presupposes awareness of the absent original it explains
tension_description: The representational puzzle at the heart of Aristotle's philosophy of mind. How does the soul recognize a present image as a likeness of an absent thing without already having access to the absent thing? This is the Aristotelian anticipation of the modern problem of intentionality.
